title: 第一部：The Bell of Silence — AUREFOLD
description: AUREFOLD 第一部：The Bell of Silence。一名牧羊女听见了一个声音；House Whitehart 的存在正是为了考验那些声称听见之人。
blocks:
The testing of what she heard falls to Brother Tomas, a man carrying the one
        thing a tester should not own — his first doubt. Above them both stands Mother
        Alaine, half a lifetime in the listening house, keeper of more memory than any
        record holds. Beyond the mountains, the ten houses are already gathering their
        testimony for a four-hundred-year jubilee, and a chronicler is coming to write
        the valley down.

对她所听之物的考验落到了 Tomas 修士身上，这个人怀揣着一名
        考验者本不该拥有的东西——他的第一份怀疑。凌驾于两人之上的是
        Alaine 嬷嬷，半生都在这座聆听之屋中度过，守护着比任何
        记录都更多的记忆。群山之外，十大家族已在为一场四百年的
        大庆典搜集各自的证言，而一名编年者正动身前来，要把
        这座山谷记录下来。

In the Light Heights — the high, silent valleys of the northwest — a goatherd named Sela hears something on the wind that she cannot explain. She will not pretend to more than she knows, and she will not take back what she does. In a realm sworn to ten great houses, that plainness is its own kind of danger.
在 the Light Heights——西北那些高耸而寂静的山谷——一名叫 Sela 的牧羊女在风中听见了她无法解释的东西。 她不愿假装知道得比自己所知更多，也不愿收回自己所说 的话。在一个立誓效忠于十大家族的国度，这份坦率本身 就是一种危险。

The Bell of Silence is a complete story in itself — but it is Book One. The second book has a name: The Road Still Open, now in development. No spoilers, no promises about when — just the road ahead. Follow the Journal and it gets written down here as it happens.
The Bell of Silence 本身是一个完整的故事——但它是第一部。第 二部已有了名字：The Road Still Open，现正在创作之中。 没有剧透，也不承诺时间——只有前方的路。关注 Journal，进展会随时记录在这里。
You can follow that road for free, or help carry the book to print. See how to support, or follow free on Patreon for every major step.
你可以免费追随这条路，也可以助力这本书走向付印。查看 如何支持，或 在 Patreon 上免费关注， 追踪每一个重要进展。
The Bell of Silence is out now as an ebook — and it's free. Read it on Amazon Kindle, or download it straight from here. The printed edition is the goal of the coming crowdfunding campaign.
The Bell of Silence 现已作为电子书上市——而且是免费的。 你可以在 Amazon Kindle 上阅读，或直接从这里下载。印刷版则是 即将到来的众筹活动的目标。

Content note. Aurefold is a mature epic fantasy for adult readers — the novels contain graphic violence and other mature themes. The free excerpt (prologue and Chapter One) is suitable for all readers.

What do you do with a truth you cannot prove — and a silence everyone else
        insists on reading for you?
一个你无法证明的真相——和一种人人都坚持替你解读的沉默，你该怎么办？

A goatherd who will not say more than she knows. A house built to test
        those who claim to hear.

一名绝不多言、只说所知的牧羊女。一个为考验那些声称
        听见之人而建立的家族。

A grounded, human epic fantasy told at the scale of one valley and one testing.
